name: DUFU
recent: Dufu 在截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日的季度录得 4 年来最高季度净利 1555 万令吉，营收同比增 31.3%。同期，公司因 ESOS 行使分批发股，已发行股本增至约 5.51 亿股。此外，首席财务官及主要子公司董事在 9 月至 10 月间多次减持股份。
notable: 截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日季度净利 1555 万令吉，为四年来最高季度利润。
因 ESOS 行使，分四批发行共约 169.7 万股新股，上市日为 2026 年 10 月 30 日。
因 ESOS 行使，分两批发行共 48.5 万股新股，上市日为 2026 年 9 月 30 日。
risks: 首席财务官 David Khoo Chong Beng 于 2026 年 9 月 22 日及 10 月 28 日分别减持 10 万股及 2.8 万股。
主要子公司董事 Wong Ser Yian 于 2026 年 10 月 5 日及 10 月 28 日分别减持 21 万股。
ESOS 新股发行导致已发行股本增加，存在股权摊薄。
earnings: 2026 年第三季营收 8962 万令吉，环比降 3.0%，同比增 31.3%；净利 1555 万令吉，环比增 11.9%，同比增 456.3%；净利率 17.4%，高于上季的 15.0%。

recent_en: Dufu posted its highest quarterly net profit in four years of MYR15.55 million for the quarter ended 30 September 2026, with revenue up 31.3% year-on-year. Meanwhile, the company issued new shares under its ESOS in several tranches, raising issued share capital to about 551 million shares. In addition, the CFO and a director of a major subsidiary disposed of shares several times between September and October.
notable_en: Net profit for the quarter ended 30 September 2026 was MYR15.55 million, the highest quarterly profit in four years.
A total of about 1.697 million new shares were issued in four tranches under the ESOS, with listing date on 30 October 2026.
A total of 485,000 new shares were issued in two tranches under the ESOS, with listing date on 30 September 2026.
risks_en: CFO David Khoo Chong Beng disposed of 100,000 shares on 22 September 2026 and 28,000 shares on 28 October 2026.
Wong Ser Yian, a director of a major subsidiary, disposed of 210,000 shares on 5 October 2026 and another 210,000 shares on 28 October 2026.
The issuance of new ESOS shares increased issued share capital, resulting in equity dilution.
earnings_en: 3Q2026 revenue was MYR89.62 million, down 3.0% QoQ but up 31.3% YoY; net profit was MYR15.55 million, up 11.9% QoQ and 456.3% YoY; net margin was 17.4%, higher than 15.0% in the previous quarter.
